title: Work & School
description: Talk about jobs, daily work routines, classes, and school life in German.
guidebook:
### Talking About Jobs & School in German

When stating your profession in German, you typically **omit the article**! While English requires "I am *a* doctor", German speakers simply say **"Ich bin Arzt"** or **"Ich bin Ärztin"**.

#### Job Titles and Gender
Most job titles change based on gender by adding the suffix **-in** for women (and sometimes adding an umlaut):
- **der Lehrer** (male teacher) → **die Lehrerin** (female teacher)
- **der Student** (male student) → **die Studentin** (female student)

#### Everyday Locations
Pay attention to handy preposition contractions when talking about your daily routine:
- **zur Schule** (to school)
- **zur Arbeit** (to work)
- **im Büro** (in the office)

phrases.native: I am going to school now.
The doctor works in the hospital.
He is sitting at his desk.
My colleague likes to drink coffee.
